purpose: Pins for nespreso_api DA profile endpoints. Not a Flask app. Load this file; do not retrain; do not swap NESPRESO_MODEL_PATH onto these .pth files.

legacy_sat_api.reason: Ozavala TorchScript + 15-PC sklearn pca_stats.pkl. Different PCA, depth, and architecture from the cells below.

hard_rules: Never mix a checkpoint with a different cache. PCA lives in the cache pickle.
Serve mu only. If forward output width is 2*d, take [:, :d]. Do not write CRPS-head sigma into NetCDF err/R.
Ingest R is Dai sigma_o after H (sigma_o_csv), floors 0.05 C / 0.02 psu. Not 1 m RMSE, not dense Sigma.
Do not apply HYCOM layer_sample here. TSIS applies H on cycle thknss.
Do not serve conv3, bathy, bathy_wind, Heave s42d, Latent, or Direct.
torch.load(..., map_location='cpu', weights_only=False); arch from ckpt['config']['arch'].

shared_sat.note: Reuse nespreso_api load_satellite_data. Harmonics: cos/sin(2pi*doy/365), cos/sin(2pi*lat/180), cos/sin(2pi*lon/360). MATLAB-style datenum is fine if doy matches the cache builder (juld % 365 in preproc_isas_sat).

A_CRPS.role: frozen TSIS ingest and OSSE xb
A_CRPS.decode: mu[:, :16] T PCs, mu[:, 16:32] S PCs; sklearn inverse_transform; native z, no warp
A_CRPS.sigma_o: csv model=A_CRPS, 3-seed mean, regime=all for the first ingest file

HeaveFast.role: heave-family challenger; basin ingest if only one heave cell ships
HeaveFast.decode: HeaveResidualFastLoss.decode_ts then physical_ts. Residual PCs are on the canonical z-grid, not native-z PCA. decode_warp raw=0 -> MLD 50 m / D26 120 m. z_bot=1800.
HeaveFast.clim_prior: These caches have no climatology/clim_profiles. Loss fallback is nanmean of cache true_profiles, broadcast to every row. Reproduce that basin-mean prior; do not nearest-neighbor Argo rows.
HeaveFast.residual_pca: Fitted inside HeaveResidualFastLoss on train-split warped residuals (chronological 70/15/15 via base.split_utils.build_split_indices). Extract t_components/t_mean/s_components/s_mean once from a loss built on this cache.
HeaveFast.sigma_o: csv model=HeaveFast, seed=42, regime=all (or lc/complement if two err profiles)

ops.role: LC-box second challenger only. Not a better basin ingest than HeaveFast.
ops.cache_inputs_note: 9 v2 columns + 19 ops. ONI/RONI splice at load -> 30. cache_hash field is still 3adcff404b0b (inherited); identify this file by path and cache_kind, not that hash.
ops.decode: same as HeaveFast; residual PCA from THIS ops cache, not the 9-d cache
ops.clim_prior: same nanmean fallback as HeaveFast, on this cache's true_profiles

ops_at_request.reason: Argo-row aligned (n=4145). Not an arbitrary (lat,lon,date) accessor.

ops.sigma_o: csv model=ops, seed=42; prefer regime=lc if splitting err profiles

netcdf_attrs.cache_hash: from cache, with ops caveat above

suggested_slices: A_CRPS (9-d sat path, cache PCA inverse)
nespreso_client model= kwarg; default URL stays Ozavala SAT
